notes:
The console's web page works again. On 2.32.0 it opened but sat frozen on "Checking free
space", the tabs did nothing when clicked, and picking files uploaded nothing. Every
console on 2.32.0 was affected, whatever you had been doing beforehand and however many
ROMs you have.

The cause was a typo in the Cover art tab that shipped with 2.32.0. It stopped the whole
page's code from running, which is why every tab died at once instead of just that one, and
why Choose files still opened the file browser: that button is the one part of the page
that needs no code. Nothing was written or lost while the page was broken, because it could
not run at all.

This release changes nothing else, and everything listed under Known issues for 2.32.0
still stands.
